systems.system: ISO 9001:2015 certification of BGFI Bank Sao Tome

note: ISO 9001 quality management certificate for a private bank, issued by Bureau Veritas, a certifier the document does not place in the country; not an IT or data standard, so no fact.

facts.fact: ISO's member directory lists SENAPIQ STP (Service National de la Propriete Intellectuelle et de la Qualite) in Sao Tome and Principe as a correspondent member; the page names no law or decree and no standard, and carries no date, so its published year 2026 is used.

systems.country_label: Service National de la Propriete Intellectuelle et de la Qualite

facts.fact: SENAPIQ-STP's own site describes it as a public institute with administrative, financial, technical and asset autonomy under the ministry responsible for industry (Ministry of Economy and Finance), whose functions include proposing policy on standardisation, certification, accreditation and metrology; it cites no law or decree and no standard, and carries no date, so its published year 2026 is used.

systems.country_label: Servico Nacional da Propriedade Intelectual e Qualidade
systems.owner: Ministry of Economy and Finance (supervising ministry)

note: The site names no national standard and no certifier or certificate.
States nothing on national IT standards for this country.
No national standards body or issued national standard stated.
